attributes.cardDescription: A point-in-time review of one employee in one cycle — ScorecardField's second consumer, with an ApprovalChainField sign-off (employee acknowledge + HR approve)
attributes.readMe:
# Performance Review

## Summary
One employee's review within one ReviewCycle. The headline reuse: this is **ScorecardField's SECOND consumer** (after Meeting's interview scorecard) — the same criteria + averageScore block, with criteria repurposed as review dimensions like "Delivery", "Collaboration", "Technical Depth". It is also **ApprovalChainField's FIFTH consumer**: the `signOff` chain models employee-acknowledge (step 0) then HR-approve (step 1).

## Fields
- `employee`, `reviewer` (linksTo Employee) — who is reviewed, who writes it.
- `cycle` (linksTo ReviewCycle) — the period this review belongs to.
- `scorecard` (contains ScorecardField) — reused UNCHANGED from scorecard-field.gts: `criteria` (containsMany of name + 1–5 ScoreField + notes), optional `recommendation`, `overallNotes`, computed `averageScore`.
- `selfAssessment`, `managerSummary` (TextAreaField) — the two written halves of the review.
- `signOff` (contains ApprovalChainField) — reused unchanged; the acknowledge-then-approve gate.
- `status` (computed) — draft (no sign-off chain yet) | in-review (chain configured, not fully approved — a rejected/sent-back chain loops here too) | signed-off.
- `employeeName`, `reviewerName`, `cycleName` (computed StringField) — DENORMALIZED copies of the linked names; prerendered fitted does not resolve linksTo, so tiles read these own-attributes.
- `scoreLabel` (computed StringField) — fitted-safe scalar from `scorecard.averageScore` (e.g. "4.3 / 5"), empty string when unscored so the tile row hides cleanly.
- `title` (computed) — "{employeeName} — {cycle name}", degrading safely when either is missing.
- `cardTitle` (computed) — `cardInfo.name || title`, so a user's rename wins in the operator-mode stack header.

## Import
```ts
import { PerformanceReview } from './performance-review';
```

## Formats
**Isolated:** header with person + cycle + reviewer, status pill and average score; then the scorecard panel (`<@fields.scorecard />`), the self-assessment and manager-summary text panels, and the sign-off chain panel (`<@fields.signOff />`).

**Embedded:** employee + cycle + score label + status pill.

**Fitted:** four tiers, each ADDING fields — ≤50px: employeeName + status pill; >50px: + scoreLabel; >80px: + cycle name; >130px: + reviewer and "N of M" sign-off progress. Attribute-only (denormalized fields, never the links). 11px floor.

**Atom:** title + score chip.

**Edit:** default field editor (link choosers, the scorecard's own containsMany criteria editor with the star widget, the chain editor).

## Usage — three ways this is used

**1. Cycle-driven manager review.** During an active ReviewCycle a manager drafts the scorecard dimensions, the employee adds a self-assessment, the manager writes the summary, then the sign-off chain runs: employee acknowledges, HR approves and files it.

**2. The tracker's future Reviews tab.** Reviews list via a live query grouped by cycle — the denormalized scoreLabel/status make the prerendered fitted grid truthful before hydration.

**3. Promotion-case evidence.** A promotion packet queries an employee's signed-off reviews across cycles; averageScore trends and managerSummary excerpts are the citable record.

## Boundary (non-goals)
A point-in-time REVIEW RECORD, not continuous feedback: no 1:1 notes, no running feedback threads, no goal/OKR tracking, no compensation outcomes — those are separate artifacts that may cite this card.

## Reuse notes
- **ScorecardField** (scorecard-field.gts) — second consumer, unchanged. One wrinkle recorded upstream: its `recommendation` enum ships interview-flavored labels (strong-hire … strong-no-hire) that read oddly in a review context, so the seeds leave it unset; a label-set parameter on the enum is upstream work, not a fork here.
- **ApprovalChainField** (approval-chain-field.gts) — fifth consumer, unchanged.

## Examples
- `PerformanceReview/priya-h2-2026` — signed-off: three scored criteria (avg 4.3), completed acknowledge+approve chain.
- `PerformanceReview/leo-h2-2026` — in-review: partially scored scorecard, both sign-off steps pending.
